requiredFindings.problem: RW-C17 requires an incorrect DDL breakdown: 6 tables, 1 explicit index and 19 triggers. The pinned selected_ddl() actually contains 7 tables, 1 explicit index and 18 triggers. The total remains 26, so the lifetime-bound argument survives, but the mandatory census assertion cannot pass on the declared baseline.
evidence: At cd5958b, crates/storage/src/ledger_store/project_ledger.rs:33-43 selects exactly the six fragments cited by the proposal.

ATTEMPT_DDL (ledger_store.rs:441-469): 1 table + 3 triggers. PAIR_DDL (:476-503): 2 tables, commit_receipts and commit_associations, + 6 triggers. AVAILABILITY_DDL (:761-774): 1 table + 1 explicit index + 3 triggers.

recovery_material::DDL (ledger_store/recovery_material.rs:13-26): 1 table + 3 triggers. recovery_pins::DDL (recovery_pins.rs:14-23): 1 table + 0 triggers. pin_transactions::DDL (pin_transactions.rs:16-31): 1 table + 3 triggers.
Independent text-only enumeration of all 26 named CREATE statements is saved in sql-source-census.json. Summing those fragments gives 7 TABLE, 1 INDEX and 18 TRIGGER; no SQLite engine was invoked.
PROPOSAL.md:512 makes the incorrect 6/1/19 split an assertion of the required RW-C17 control, rather than an incidental explanatory count.
requiredFindings.fix: Correct every subject occurrence of the breakdown to 7 tables, 1 explicit index and 18 triggers, including the response table, item 3.3 and RW-C17. Keep k = 26 and the correctly listed per-fragment totals. Have the future census enumerate the statements actually selected; do not change the product DDL to fit the prose. Keep RW-C5 and its stop rule/fallback.

requiredFindings.problem: The trust-completion authorization and controls still assume that publication follows a successfully admitted current-trust view. Integrated X4-F2 changes that routing: a fenced read can reach the same publication steps with a deferred clocked refusal and never return an admitted view. J-RW does not state whether C-TRUST/C-TDIR are authorized on that required write-ahead path, or its terminal/refusal expectations. Keeping a successful-view gate would leave those repairable publication objects blocking the mandatory write-ahead; applying completion there would exceed the stated successful-admission premise. RW-S5 also still names the already-used X4T r12 revision without composing with its new rule.
evidence: The request explicitly requires a finding if X4-F2 changes routing J-RW relies on. At cd5958b, floor_publication.rs:958-995 obtains an AdmittedCurrentTrust before publish and returns Ok(view). The proposal relies on that order at :336, :365 and RW-C15 :504.

At d2c00a9, crates/security/src/trust/current_trust_admission.rs:243-259 distinguishes Admission::View from Admission::Clocked; :1113-1125 retains pending write-ahead with a clocked continuation refusal. :283-289 converts Clocked into Err(refusal), never an AdmittedCurrentTrust.

At d2c00a9, floor_publication.rs:961-995 carries either admission through check 3, takes its pending write, and calls publish at :993 before into_view at :995. Thus parent_dir and write_dependency can run for a clock-refused request as well as for a successful view.

Static routing example, not executed: an authenticated store has an RW-T3 ACL-omitted empty predecessor directory, time admission proposes a floor advance, and EV-CLOCK yields core:stale-revocation or core:expired. The required publication reaches that directory before the continuation refusal. Successful C-TDIR would finish publication and then return that continuation refusal; it does not cause an admitted view or a committed request.

X4T PROPOSAL-r12.md:170-175 expressly requires the same write-ahead and owner advance before a clocked refusal, with no view returned; :205 puts that refusal before every lease and later operation effect. The accepted r11 snapshot alone cannot describe this route.
The integrated test source floor_publication_tests.rs:801-849 describes a confirmed write-ahead followed by CONTINUE-CORE-NOT-TRUSTED and no view. This source was inspected only; no test was run.
X4-F2 does not change open_private or its lift mapping: the N-T2a/N-T2b native-open/custody split itself remains correct. The finding concerns the enclosing admission/publication route.
requiredFindings.fix: Compose J-RW explicitly with integrated X4T r12. State whether and on what authenticated-closure/pending-write authority C-TRUST and C-TDIR complete the required floor publication before a deferred clock refusal, without manufacturing an admitted view or granting a lease. Preserve the closure non-reference proof, fence and existing refusal precedence. Update item 2, items 3.5/3.6, relevant terminal wording and RW-C14/RW-C15; require future controls for completion followed by the unchanged clocked continuation refusal and for native/custody/budget failures on that path. Place RW-S5 on the next X4T successor of r12, retaining r12’s clock and write-ahead rules. Keep earlier authentication/time refusals and report-only reads effect-free. No test or matrix run is requested for this law revision.
